name: claude.lifecycle.setup

ZCode action_required requires the returned UI steps; it does not claim the plugin loaded. remove retains Task data; ZCode --confirm-host-removed records actual user confirmation only. A failed command may leave completed registration steps; inspect status before another mutation.
